notes.offline: No live API calls. Synthetic and tracked-fixture tests run here; optional local-corpus cases in mixed modules must report explicit skips when absent.
notes.collected: Only separately collected snapshots; invoke the named test explicitly after preparing its local data. Never download or collect from this registry.
notes.api_local: Manual local use only. These tests can send private input to an external AI service and must never enter an automatic test suite.

dependencies.scripts/test_tax_audit_verifier.py: Synthetic mutation fixtures and mocked CLI; no collected corpus, network or AI.
dependencies.scripts/test_tax_reverse_verifier.py: Synthetic reverse-source and click-destination mutation fixtures; no collected corpus, network or AI.
dependencies.scripts/test_tax_source_repairs.py: Synthetic XML/text repair, edition/hash and offset fixtures; no collection or live API.
dependencies.scripts/test_tax_citation_context.py: Synthetic annex context and tracked exact public-source table fixture; no collection or live API.
dependencies.scripts/test_law_abbrev.py: Tracked data/law-snapshot-manifest.json and law graph (core.law_universe.load_graph); no API.
dependencies.scripts/test_static_galaxies.py: Node.js is required; optional source-corpus comparison reports unittest skip when missing.
dependencies.scripts/test_galaxy_sound.cjs: Isolated legacy sound-module regression only; it does not imply that sound is loaded by the public or local renderer.
dependencies.scripts/test_procurement_ui.py: Local procurement, FSC and local-tax snapshots.
dependencies.scripts/test_housing_ui.py: Local housing, procurement, FSC and local-tax snapshots.
dependencies.scripts/test_environment_ui.py: Local environment, housing, procurement, FSC and local-tax snapshots.
dependencies.scripts/test_mofe_ui.py: Local customs, treasury and public-institutions snapshots.
dependencies.scripts/test_delegation_collected.mjs: LAW_ORBIT_TEST_SITE must identify a validated public site; deployment CI supplies _site.
dependencies.scripts/test_llm_review_golden.py: Local untracked expectations and draft plus ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; live external AI, manual authorization only.
dependencies.scripts/test_tax_annex_catalog.py: Synthetic canonical annex lookup and exact official-file container guards; no network or legal-data collection.
